name: signaller
description: /signaller switches Signaller between rules, Anthropic and the router's downstreams for this session; /signaller <downstream> [tier] window|model <value> sets this session's settings line, /signaller <downstream> reset clears it; /signaller name labels the session in the console; Claude can switch and set both too (signaller_lever tool), gated by the typed commands; the status line shows the mode.
